headline: Every Comet Drift HD start line now wears its own face
lede: HD had two shapes for four courses — Corkscomb and Dry Lake starts stood under the Gulch's sandstone arch. Both ports shipped: a dune ridge sculpted from the same silhouette law the 2D game paints, and a lattice farm windmill whose wheel turns as the world ticks. Sandbank keeps its timing gantry, the Gulch its arch.

notes.text: buildDune maps art.js's duneCrest law onto both flanks of the start — windward shoulder, crest, slipface, second dune behind — with the road notch computed from the live wall law, so nothing ever stands over usable road.
buildWindmill is GP's sprite in the round: tapered lattice tower, twenty X-braces, eight-sail wheel, tail vane, concrete pad — planted beyond the wall line, wheel spinning off the world clock.

Shipping un-crashed cometdrifthdcheck on the way (#1865): the audit lost its course id in #1498 and the suite had been frozen mid-run since Nov 3. What it revealed behind the crash — hairpin walls measured at 49px against the old 170 floor — is documented on #1865 for the QA lane's redress.
29 new gates (including vertex-for-vertex equality against the shared law) and two mutants that die 8 and 12 gates; cometcheck, all four lints, build, and a zero-page-error browser drive green.
